lines.text: We need automated dispatching for twenty field vans across the state.
Brightpath handles fleet routing easily, and we can configure your accounts.
We will have your SAML single sign-on live within two weeks of signature.
That fits our IT requirement. How quickly can you train our dispatchers?
We provide two admin training sessions completed within seven days of onboarding.
Can we also get custom analytics reports for van fuel usage?
We could probably look into custom report builders down the road, let me check.
Our mobile application works seamlessly on both iOS and Android devices.
Great. We will send your team our technician roster by next Tuesday.
